profile.headline: AI Engineer | Robotics Software Engineer | Rust for Robotics | ATAK Developer | Web Apps | Agentic Applications | Mobile Apps | UI/UX
profile.summary: I’m a startup robotics engineer with a passion for building all types of intelligent systems — from aerial drones and walking robots to multi-agent collaborative platforms. I specialize in robotic software architecture and hold a Bachelor’s in Mechatronics Engineering and a Master’s in Robotics and Intelligent Systems from Kennesaw State University. Recently, I’ve been developing a modular ROS 2 + Rust autonomy stack and exploring humanoid robot software as my next challenge. I enjoy working on the cutting edge of technology and pushing the boundaries of what robots can achieve.

positions.title: Robotics Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a plugin for ATAK to command missions for autonomous underwater robots, enhancing operational efficiency.  
• Created intuitive graphical user interfaces for embedded systems and mission command, improving user experience.  
• Engineered UUV simulations using NVIDIA Omniverse's Isaac Sim, facilitating advanced testing and development.  
• Implemented web interfaces for maritime robots with React and Node.js, streamlining user interaction and data management.

positions.description: Lead the design and implementation of autonomous robotics systems using ROS. positions.title: Physics Workshop Facilitator
positions.description:
• Facilitated a comprehensive General Physics workshop every Friday for top-performing STEM students.  
• Developed engaging lesson plans to address challenging physics topics, enhancing students' understanding and performance.  
• Fostered a collaborative learning environment that encouraged peer-to-peer interaction and problem-solving skills.  
• Contributed to Atlanta Metropolitan State College's mission of advancing STEM education in the Greater Atlanta Area.

positions.title: Jr Lab Assistant
positions.description:
• Prepared growth mediums for bacterial cultures, ensuring optimal conditions for experimentation.  
• Conducted chemical testing and autoclaving processes to maintain lab safety and compliance.  
• Proposed innovative experiments and rapidly prototyped fixtures, enhancing lab efficiency and productivity.  
• Maintained meticulous data filing systems, improving accessibility and organization of research data.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Evaluated the biocompatibility of commercially available polymers, enhancing material selection for biomedical applications.  
• Designed scaffolds with 500-micron pore sizes using AutoCAD, contributing to improved tissue engineering outcomes.  
• Conducted in vitro studies with MC3T3-E1 cells, utilizing live/dead assays and Alamar Blue for accurate cell viability assessments.  
• Chaired a research symposium on Nanotechnology and Biomedicine, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing among peers.

positions.title: Aerospace Scholar
positions.description:
• Participated in a prestigious semester-long scholars program at NASA, focusing on Mars exploration.  
• Led a team to design a semi-autonomous rover, achieving first place in the robotics competition.  
• Developed a comprehensive marketing and branding strategy to support our fictional company's objectives.  
• Gained hands-on experience in project management, budget allocation, and team collaboration within a high-stakes environment.

projects.title: Hexapod-Zero
projects.description: Developing custom software for a six-legged autonomous robot. Integrated NVIDIA Jetson TX2 system on chip (SoC) technology to run deep learning algorithms on edge. Created web interfaces for remote teleoperation. Managing marketing campaigns and start-up initiatives. Hexapod-Zero is the premier solution for learning how to develop autonomous multi-legged robotics software.

projects.title: KUKA KR210 Pick and Place
projects.description:
Developed software using the Robotics Operating Systems (ROS) to integrate a KUKA KR210 serial manipulator, and an RGB camera to autonomously locate, pick up and place objects in a work space.

Filtering, segmentation and object detection algorithms were written in Python to enable the robot to located objects in a simulated environment. Motion and path planning algorithm were also written in Python.

organizations.description: Developed a concept for a wearable heartbeat monitor for a new species of crabs from Columbia, South America
